description: This script defines a PHP class Upgrade12 within the Opencart installation upgrade namespace. The class extends a system controller and contains a method 'index' that performs database upgrade tasks such as updating serialized data to JSON, adding new data fields, and cleaning up old fields related to order data in an Opencart e-commerce platform during an upgrade process.

classes.name: Upgrade12
classes.description: A controller class for handling upgrade 12 tasks in the Opencart installation system, including updating serialized order data, migrating fields to JSON, and removing obsolete database columns.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs database schema updates and data migrations specific to upgrade 12, involving unserializing, re-encoding as JSON, updating order data, adding shipping and payment info, and cleaning up old columns.
